ucs.title: [LLM] Seashell Blizzard (Sandworm) pre-wipe recovery-inhibition + shadow-copy destruction cluster
ucs.description: Hunts the destructive payload signature shared across Sandworm's NotPetya, Prestige ransomware, CaddyWiper and Industroyer2 operations: clustered execution of native recovery-sabotage binaries (vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit/wevtutil/fsutil) on a single host within minutes, immediately before mass file destruction/encryption. Sandworm characteristically blinds recovery and event logs before detonating the wiper.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wevtutil.exe","fsutil.exe","diskshadow.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval is_inhibit=if(match(process,"(?i)(delete\s+(shadows|catalog|systemstatebackup)|resize\s+shadowstorage|shadowcopy\s+delete|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|usn\s+deletejournal|\bcl\b|clear-log)"),1,0)
| where is_inhibit=1
| stats dc(process_name) as technique_count values(commands) as commands min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user
| where technique_count>=2
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let window = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wevtutil.exe","fsutil.exe","diskshadow.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","deletejournal","clear-log","cl ")
// machine-context wipers do run as SYSTEM, so do NOT exclude $ accounts here
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(FileName), Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 10), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, window)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2   // 2+ distinct recovery-inhibition binaries in 10m = wiper/ransomware detonation staging
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let window = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wevtutil.exe","fsutil.exe","diskshadow.exe","wmic.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage","shadowcopy delete","delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","deletejournal","clear-log")
| summarize TechniqueCount = dcount(tolower(NewProcessName)), Commands = make_set(CommandLine, 20),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, window)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2   // 2+ distinct recovery-inhibition binaries in 10m
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Sandworm-style system recovery inhibition command
id: 7d9a4c11-3b2e-4f6a-9c8d-2e1f0a5b7c34
status: experimental
description: Detects native recovery-sabotage commands characteristic of Sandworm wiper/ransomware detonation (vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit/wevtutil/fsutil). High-fidelity when several fire on one host in a short window.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1485
  - attack.g0034
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vss:
    Image|endswith: ['\vssadmin.exe', '\wmic.exe', '\diskshadow.exe']
    CommandLine|contains|all: ['shadow', 'delete']
  wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'delete'
  bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  logclear:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' cl '
  usn:
    Image|endswith: '\fsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'deletejournal'
  condition: 1 of vss or wbadmin or bcdedit or logclear or usn
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup software pruning shadow storage
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBAdmin.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\wevtutil.exe OR *\WevtUtil.exe OR *\fsutil.exe OR *\Fsutil.exe OR *\diskshadow.exe OR *\DiskShadow.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*vssadmin* OR *VSSAdmin* OR *wbadmin* OR *bcdedit*)) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"resize shadowstorage"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *deletejournal*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin|bcdedit|wevtutil|fsutil|diskshadow)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(delete\s+(shadows|catalog|systemstatebackup)|resize\s+shadowstorage|shadowcopy\s+delete|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|usn\s+deletejournal|\s+cl\s+)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=([count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=technique_count), collect([CommandLine]), min(_time, as=firstTime), max(_time, as=lastTime)]))
| technique_count>=2
ucs.rationale: Inhibiting recovery is universal to many ransomware crews, but the SCOPE here is Sandworm-specific: their destructive payloads (NotPetya MBR wipe, Prestige, CaddyWiper, Industroyer2) consistently fire MULTIPLE distinct recovery-sabotage binaries plus event-log clearing in a tight burst on a single host as the final detonation step. ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm GPO-driven mass payload deployment from SYSVOL/NETLOGON (Prestige / CaddyWiper)
ucs.description: Hunts Sandworm's domain-wide deployment mechanism: staging the wiper/ransomware binary in the Default Domain Policy SYSVOL/NETLOGON share and executing it on every host via a Group Policy startup/scheduled-task script (gpscript.exe). Used to push Prestige ransomware (2022) and CaddyWiper across Ukrainian victims — distinct from manual lateral movement and a hallmark of Seashell Blizzard's destruction-at-scale tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.process_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="gpscript.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")) OR (Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" AND Processes.process="*/create*" AND (Processes.process="*\\sysvol\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\netlogon\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*")) OR (Processes.process_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\NETLOGON\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| stats dc(dest) as host_count values(process) as commands values(process_path) as paths min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by parent_process_name process_name
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - host_count
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe"
           and FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe"))
      or (FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
           and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\sysvol\\","\\netlogon\\","\\\\"))
      or (FolderPath has_any ("\\sysvol\\","\\netlogon\\") and FileName endswith ".exe")
| extend Mechanism = case(
      InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe", "GPO startup/logon script",
      FileName =~ "schtasks.exe", "Scheduled task referencing UNC/SYSVOL",
      "Binary executed from SYSVOL/NETLOGON")
| summarize HostCount = dcount(DeviceName), Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 50),
            Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by Mechanism, FileName, FolderPath
| order by HostCount desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe"
           and NewProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe"))
      or (NewProcessName endswith "\\schtasks.exe" and CommandLine has "/create"
           and CommandLine has_any ("\\sysvol\\","\\netlogon\\","\\\\"))
      or (NewProcessName has_any ("\\sysvol\\","\\netlogon\\") and NewProcessName endswith ".exe")
| extend Mechanism = case(
      ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe", "GPO startup/logon script",
      NewProcessName endswith "\\schtasks.exe", "Scheduled task referencing UNC/SYSVOL",
      "Binary executed from SYSVOL/NETLOGON")
| summarize HostCount = dcount(Computer), Hosts = make_set(Computer, 50),
            Commands = make_set(CommandLine, 20), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Mechanism, NewProcessName
| order by HostCount desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Execution from SYSVOL/NETLOGON or GPO script spawning interpreter (Sandworm mass-deploy)
id: c2e8b073-1a44-4d9b-8f3e-6a7c9d0e1b25
status: experimental
description: Detects Sandworm-style domain-wide payload deployment - binaries executed from the SYSVOL/NETLOGON share or a GPO startup script (gpscript.exe) spawning a command interpreter.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1484.001
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.g0034
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sysvol_exec:
    Image|contains:
      - '\SYSVOL\'
      - '\NETLOGON\'
    Image|endswith: '.exe'
  gpo_script_spawn:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  condition: sysvol_exec or gpo_script_spawn
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate GPO-deployed login scripts that wrap interpreters
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@ParentImage:(*\gpscript.exe OR *\GPScript.exe) AND @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe)) OR (@Image:(*\SYSVOL\* OR *\sysvol\* OR *\NETLOGON\* OR *\netlogon\*) AND @Image:*.exe) OR (@Image:(*\schtasks.exe OR *\SchTasks.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*\sysvol\* OR *\SYSVOL\* OR *\netlogon\* OR *\NETLOGON\*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ParentBaseFileName=/gpscript\.exe/i AND ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta)\.exe$/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(sysvol|netlogon)\\.*\.exe$/i) OR (ImageFileName=/schtasks\.exe/i AND CommandLine=/\/create/i AND CommandLine=/\\(sysvol|netlogon)\\/i)
| groupBy([ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function=([count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=host_count), collect([ComputerName, CommandLine]), min(_time, as=firstTime), max(_time, as=lastTime)]))
| sort(host_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: This catches the deployment mechanism that distinguishes Sandworm's 2022 destruction campaigns (Prestige ransomware, CaddyWiper, Industroyer2) from generic ransomware-as-a-service crews: rather than hands-on-keyboard lateral movement, they weaponize the victim's own Group Policy to stage the payload in SYSVOL/NETLOGON and detonate it simultaneously across the entire domain.
